    Recording studio and rehearsal prices

    Here are Sanctum Sound’s recording studio prices in Warsaw, along with what each rate actually covers, so you can plan your budget before you book. The final cost of a project depends mainly on how much time it needs.

    Recording

    from 120 zł/hour
    • Sound engineer support
    • Full equipment access
    • Digital file delivery
    • One revision included

    Rehearsal

    from 50 zł/hour
    • Full backline on-site
    • PA system
    • Flexible dates
    • Free cables for rehearsal

    Equipment Rental

    Optional
    • Professional PA system
    • Microphones, synths, cables and accessories
    • Drums
    • Guitar and bass amps and cabinets
    • Technical support
    • Delivery available

    Mixing & Mastering

    from 400 zł/song
    • Editing and mastering included
    • Unlimited revisions
    • Industry standard quality
    • Publishing assistance

    Recording — from 120 PLN per hour

    Our recording studio hourly rate starts at 120 PLN and includes:

    • A sound engineer at every session
    • Full access to the studio gear
    • Digital files of your recordings
    • One revision

    Mixing and mastering — from 400 PLN per song

    Mixing and mastering are priced per song rather than per hour, so you know the cost upfront. The price includes:

    • Editing
    • Unlimited revisions
    • Help with preparing your release

    Rehearsal room — from 50 PLN per hour

    The rehearsal room can be booked by the hour or as a regular weekly slot. Every booking includes the full backline (tube guitar amps, bass amps and a drum kit), an 800 W PA, free cables, air conditioning and free coffee or tea.

    Equipment rental — individual quote

    PA systems, microphones, guitar and bass amps, stands, cables and keyboards are available for hire. Each rental is quoted individually, depending on the gear, the dates and whether you need delivery.

    How much does it cost to record a song?

    It depends on how long the recording takes. As an example: if your vocals take two hours, recording comes to 240 PLN, and with mixing and mastering added the finished song costs from 640 PLN. A band recording several instruments will need more studio time; a rapper with a finished beat and well-rehearsed verses often needs less.

    Studio hire in Warsaw: how to book

    Book through the contact form on this site, by phone at +48 881 238 684 or on Instagram at @sanctum_sound_studio. Describe your project and we’ll tell you how much time to plan for.

    Questions and answers

    Is the sound engineer included in the price?

    Yes. A sound engineer runs every recording session, and that’s included in the rate from 120 PLN per hour.

    What’s the difference between the revision in recording and the revisions in mixing?

    The recording rate includes one revision. Mixing and mastering, from 400 PLN per song, include unlimited revisions until you’re happy with the result.

    Can I get an estimate for a whole project?

    Yes. Tell us how many songs you have and what needs recording, and we’ll estimate the studio time and cost for you.

    How much does equipment hire cost?

    Equipment rental is quoted individually, based on the items, the rental period and delivery.
